{{Top|leg}}
The '''Noonar Confederacy''' was a government based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Noonar]] that controlled a key stretch of territory between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. A pacifist and neutral state, the Confederacy was nonetheless convinced by one of the galactic powers to allow temporary access to its territory for what they believed to be nonmilitary purposes.<ref name="NIR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Neutrality is Relative}}</ref>
